test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an examination, Raman scored more marks than Prince. Robin scored less marks than Keshav and Deepak. Abhishek scored more marks than Deepak but less marks than Prince. Deepak scored more marks than Keshav. Who scored the third highest marks in the exam?
solution:
Given:

1) In an examination, Raman scored more marks than Prince. 

Raman > Prince

2) Abhishek scored more marks than Deepak but less marks than Prince.

Raman > Prince > Abhishek > Deepak

3) Deepak scored more marks than Keshav.

Raman > Prince > Abhishek > Deepak > Keshav

4) Robin scored less marks than Keshav and Deepak.

Raman > Prince > Abhishek > Deepak > Keshav > Robin

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Abhishek scored the third highest marks in the exam.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
